verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents a built-in Automations scheduler that persists jobs, wakes the agent, and delivers output to a chat channel or webhook. It also supports event triggers through Gateway HTTP hooks and Gmail PubSub, and standing orders give the agent permanent authority over defined programs. A community user confirms scheduling tasks across agents. Missing for 10: documented conditional rule logic (filters or if-then matching on event content), event sources beyond cron/webhooks/Gmail (e.g., triggers on incoming chat messages), and hands-on corroboration of event-triggered rules working.
